ignorePatterns:
Cargo.lock
runtime/browser/dist/
compiler/tests/golden/**/*.stderr
compiler/tests/golden/**/*.json
compiler/tests/golden/**/*.wgsl
compiler/tests/golden/**/*.wat
results/

rules.rule: The compiler must never panic on any input: flag unwrap, expect, unchecked indexing and arithmetic overflow on paths reachable from user source.
Compiler output must be deterministic (byte-identical builds): flag iteration over HashMap or HashSet whose order reaches output.

The compiler knows nothing about the engine: flag keywords, attributes, lang items or rules phrased in engine terms (creatures, meshes, render frames, distance fields). General language terms, such as struct fields, are fine.
The `ci` job is the only check the main ruleset requires. Every other job must be in its `needs` list, and it must fail when any of them did not succeed.
